title: Interpret current handoffs with explicit reliance and gaps
statement: The MOD-006 responsibility shall interpret current handoffs with explicit reliance and gaps within the selected project and Change scope.

what.problem: Resumption can otherwise invent missing context or authority and lose obligations still relied upon.
what.desired_outcome: Interpret current handoffs with explicit reliance and gaps.

why.rationale: SR-006 requires a complete accountable contribution beyond general workflow progression or adoption.

conditions: A participant resumes or progresses governed work and prepares its next handoff.

contexts: The selected project, Change, adopted contract and exact action context.

how.approach: Apply the MOD-006 README.md handoff and authority collaboration through IF-011/009 with explicit participant-mediated IF-004 recording.

how_much.scope: Semantic resumption or authority interpretation. Operational maintenance execution, runtime adoption and overall IR-003 satisfaction remain separate.

acceptance_criteria: Return all seven current handoff sections through IF-011 from authoritative record and subject references, with one semantic owner per fact and an identified next action, reason and responsible owner.

Use attributable supported bounded reads and complete selectors over one coherent project, Change and contract basis; report omitted, unavailable, stale or conflicting facts without inferring absence, approval or completion.
Keep actual outcomes, planned checks, not-applicable explanations, issue disposition, review standing and authority distinct; route returns changed-subject assessment applicability to its owner.
Prepare meaningful updates before dependent decisions or transfer and carry them through explicit IF-004 recording, preserving concurrent facts and reconciling uncertain effects before retry.

Permit comparable current summary replacement and selective detail retention while preserving unresolved issues and result, scope, basis, limitations and support still relied upon; require attributable disposition before compaction.

Expose restored retained state and unavailable later work without renewing authority or review; keep compact historical completion and its acceptance meaning distinct from current health and linked regression work.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Derive current handoff interpretation and action-bound authority through existing IF-011/009, with explicit participant recording, selective retention and one MOD-006 owner. Proposed Design only; no runtime adoption, execution or satisfaction claim.
